sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Petoskey State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483532, map 'Tannery Creek': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2027-05-18, 05-21, 05-22, 07-13, 07-16, 07-17, 07-18)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $48 a night at the 65 sites on the 20/30-amp fee schedule ($51 on the July Friday and Saturday nights sampled; May weekends $48); the 33 sites on the 50-amp schedule are $53 ($56 those July weekend nights). 2026 (DNR rates table): $45 at 20/30-amp sites, $50 at 50-amp. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Petoskey State Park, Tannery Creek map: 65 campsites on fee schedule -32475 at $48 for 2027-05-18, 05-21, 05-22, 07-13, 07-18 and $51 for 2027-07-16 and 07-17; 33 on fee schedule -32476 at $53 / $56 the same dates) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Petoskey, Tannery Creek: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $50, 20/30 AMP rate $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Tannery Creek: 'All sites have 20- and 30-amp service, and a handful of sites have 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tannery Creek map: 64 campsites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps', 34 '20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps'; all 98 'Sewer Hookup=No'; water hookup not listed), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Paved pads. The booking site allows trailers/RVs up to 40 ft at 6 sites, 35 ft at 9, 30 ft at 13, 25 ft at 41 and 20 ft at 28; one site is tents only. Posted site lengths 27-60 ft. Every site is listed 'Pull Through=No', although the DNR page's tags include 'Pull-through sites available'. Overflow parking for extra vehicles. Two mini cabins in the campground besides the 98 sites.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Petoskey Tannery Creek Modern Campground: 'There are paved pads at each site', 'There's an overflow parking area available for campground use only', 'Number of sites: 98'; tag 'Pull-through sites available'; 'There are two mini cabins in the Tannery Creek Campground') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tannery Creek map: 98 campsites + 2 mini cabins; allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to 40'' at 6, 35' at 9, 30' at 13, 25' at 41, 20' at 28, tents only at 1; Site Length 27-60 ft; all 'Pull Through=No'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Tannery Creek tags 'Modern campground, Pull-through sites available, Sanitation station, State park campground, Toilet & shower building, Vault toilet, Water access') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots for fresh/potable water and electrical'; Petoskey Tannery Creek toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Petoskey Tannery Creek Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Petoskey, Tannery Creek: reservation season starts 'May 15', ends 'October 14') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (98 bookable Tannery Creek campsites), read 2026-10-25

summary: New entry filled from the DNR park page, the DNR rates table and the MiDNRReservations Tannery Creek map: $48-51 base (2027; 2026 $45), 50-amp at 34 sites (20/30 at all), no sewer, 98 paved sites allowed to 40 ft, no pull-throughs on the booking site, showers/flush toilets/dump/potable water, reservable on MiDNRReservations or by phone, reservation season May 15 - Oct 14. Operating season not stated, so season left absent. No closure notice. Phone 231-347-2311 matches. Location, waterfront, evidence and note untouched.
flags: The DNR page tags Tannery Creek 'Pull-through sites available' but every one of its 98 sites is 'Pull Through=No' on MiDNRReservations; pull_through written false from the per-site listing.
The DNR page says 'a handful of sites have 50-amp service'; the booking site lists 50-amp at 34 of 98 (33 of them on the $53 fee schedule).
